secret.replaceUsed_one: {{name}} is already in Secrets and {{count}} connector uses it. Replacing it changes what that connector sends.

list.title: Connectors
list.importHint: Paste an mcpServers JSON config, as Claude Desktop or Cursor writes it
list.atCap: Your account is at its limit of {{max}} connectors. Remove one in Plugins first.
list.empty: No connectors yet. Add one or import a JSON config.

tab.pluginsHint: Connectors, skills, sign-ins and keys on your account
tab.accountHint: Connectors live on your account and are switched on per workspace. One you add here stays off in your other workspaces, and in new ones, until you switch it on there.
tab.addNote: Adds the connector to your account and switches it on only in this workspace. Your other workspaces, including new ones, start with it off.
tab.startingWorkspace: Starting the workspace. Your connectors are checked as soon as it's up.
tab.workspaceStopped: The workspace is stopped. Saving a connector starts it again and checks the connector.

row.accountHint: Installed on your account. Switching it off here affects only this workspace.
row.removeHint: Switch it off to stop using it here. To remove it from your account, go to Plugins.

status.pendingHint: Not checked yet. Start the workspace, or test the connection.

modal.entryHint: Paste an MCP endpoint URL, a command like npx -y <package>, or a JSON config from Claude Desktop or Cursor. The rest is worked out from it.
modal.detectedStdio: Local command, runs in your workspace
modal.filledFromMore_one: Filled from "{{name}}". {{count}} more connector in the config: use Import JSON to add them all.
modal.filledFromMore_other: Filled from "{{name}}". {{count}} more connectors in the config: use Import JSON to add them all.
modal.pasteNoServer: No connector found in the pasted config.
modal.nameHint: Letters, digits and underscores. Suggested from the address; change it if you like.
modal.nameShape: Name must be 1-64 characters: a letter or underscore, then letters, digits or underscores
modal.nameReservedRuntime: "{{name}}" is reserved: the sandbox's MCP runtime module already has that name
modal.nameReservedDunder: Name must not start with "__": a connector's name becomes a Python module in the sandbox, and those names are Python's own
modal.nameReservedKeyword: "{{name}}" is a Python keyword, and a connector's name becomes a Python module in the sandbox
modal.envHint: Paste a value, or pick a key from Secrets.
modal.headersHint: Paste the key, or pick one from Secrets. The check below sends it.
modal.blankKey: Name is required. A row without a name is not saved.
modal.duplicateHeader: Each header name can appear only once
modal.duplicateEnvKey: Each variable name can appear only once
modal.transportHint: Detected from the address or command. Change it only if the detection is wrong.
modal.descriptionHint: Helps the agent decide when to reach for this connector.
modal.instructionHint: Extra guidance the agent reads before it calls this connector's tools.
modal.instructionPlaceholder: How the agent should use this connector
modal.exposureHint: Detailed lists full tool schemas in the prompt (bounded by caps).
modal.discoveryForced: This connector sends a key in a header, so listing its tools has to use your keys.
modal.discoveryHint: Off (default): its tools are listed without your keys. Switch on only if this connector needs a key to list its tools.
modal.discoveryToggle: Use my keys to list its tools
modal.stdioCheckNote: Adding runs this command in your workspace to list its tools, which can take up to a minute and a half. It is saved only if that works.
modal.testSavedHint: Lists the tools of the saved connector. Save first to test your edits.
modal.nameTakenYours: You already have a connector named {{name}}. Pick another name, or edit that one.
modal.nameTakenReserved: {{name}} is the name of a built-in connector. Pick another name.
modal.nameSuffixed: You already have a connector named {{taken}}, so this one is named {{name}}.
modal.nameSuffixedReserved: {{taken}} is the name of a built-in connector, so this one is named {{name}}.
modal.placeholderValue: This looks like a placeholder, not the real value. Paste the real one.
modal.placeholderArg: This looks like a placeholder. Put the real value here.
modal.placeholdersBlock: Replace the placeholders marked above before adding.
modal.sseRefused: Legacy SSE connectors can't be added. Most servers also answer over HTTP at the same address, often ending in /mcp.
modal.sseEditNote: This connector uses legacy SSE, which new connectors can't use. Switch it to HTTP if the server supports it.
modal.stdioCannotCancel: This can't be cancelled: closing the form would not stop the save, so it stays open until the check ends.
modal.urlScheme: Use an https:// address. Connectors are only reached over a secure connection.
modal.urlLocal: Connectors can't reach localhost or a private network address. For a server you run yourself, paste the command that starts it instead.
modal.urlUserinfo: Take the user name and password out of the address, and send the key as a header instead.
modal.urlSecret: Keys can't go in the address. Add the key as a header instead.
modal.urlMalformed: This isn't a complete address. Check it for a typo.
modal.importNotAdded: The import didn't add this connector:

probe.authCredentialMissing: This connector wants a key. Add it as a header above, then check again.
probe.authOauth: This connector signs in with OAuth. Adding opens its sign-in page; nothing is saved until you sign in.
probe.missingSecrets: These keys have no value in Secrets yet: {{names}}
probe.credentialRejected: The connector rejected that key. Check it and paste it again.
probe.saveToCheck: Save to check the new address with its key.
probe.keyAdded: Key added. Check the connector with it now.
probe.keyHeld: The key is sent only when you check, so make sure the address is right first.
probe.failedDns: This address doesn't exist. Check the host name for a typo.
probe.failedTimeout: The connector didn't answer in time. It may be down; try again later.
probe.failedRefused: Nothing answered at this address. Check the URL and port.
probe.failedBlocked: This address is on a private network, which connectors can't reach.
probe.failedNotEndpoint: This address isn't an MCP endpoint. Check the path; it often ends in /mcp.
probe.failedServerError: The connector is having trouble right now. Try again later.
probe.failedRateLimited: The connector is limiting requests. Wait a minute, then check again.
probe.failedHandshake: The connector answered but refused the MCP handshake. Check that the address is its MCP endpoint.
